title: The header search window holds focus, returns it, and has valid roles (SCAN-1028)
detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-22. The search dialog declared aria-modal but let Tab leave it and never gave focus back; its results wrapped plain links in role listbox (invalid); and a bare slash key opened it, which WCAG 2.1.4 asks us not to do. Tab now wraps inside the window, closing returns focus to the opener, the results are a labelled group, and the shortcut is Ctrl or Cmd + K with a plain Search label on the buttons.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const s=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/site/shell/site-header.tsx','utf8');const bad=[];if(s.includes('role=\"listbox\"'))bad.push('results still claim listbox');if(s.includes(\"e.key === '/'\"))bad.push('bare slash shortcut is back');if(!s.includes('searchRef'))bad.push('search window has no focus trap');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-1028: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the search window loses its focus trap, regains an invalid listbox role, or opens on a bare key.
